scope: Original 3D dorsal exoskeleton reconstruction of Paradoxides davidis davidis; NOT whole living organism or complete ventral anatomy. Artist-neutral closed underside solely for solid asset technical validity, not fossil anatomical evidence.

taxon.context: Middle Cambrian; type locality Porth-y-rhaw, Wales
anchors: Bergström & Levi-Setti1978 Plate2 Fig1 BM I1 cast of near-complete exuviae
Same study Fig7A restored dorsal morphology

scale.basis: Artist nominal meters, no exact specimen metric; elevation/ventral thickness unknown from compressed exuviae.

pose: Straight extended dorsal exoskeleton without substrate slab, legs, antennae or any soft parts; head -Y. Reconstruct continuous bilateral dorsal shield, not compressed crack geometry.

surface_profile.name: palette-only
surface_profile.materials: 4–6 subdued gray/olive/slate/tan palette values, not fossil pigment claim. No emissive eyes.
surface_profile.detail: Closed solid geometry, single-sided opaque materials, subtle planar sculpting; no DoubleSide sheets, detached bead limbs or noisy repeated detail. Integument and colors artistic, not preserved facts.

coordinates.origin: Centered footprint of shell projected to underside baseline Z0; no feet or substrate.

view_plan.source: Exact final GLB clean-import, fixed numeric camera/light/color template and hash-bound manifest.
view_plan.greybox: Inspect dorsal silhouette/20 tergites and finite relief; closure must remain shallow and subordinate, not a slab or invented animal belly.
view_plan.extra_views: Only targeted diagnostic for concrete ambiguity; no mandatory8 views in current scoped making.

scientific_limits: Source is cast/replica photography of exuviae with compression and displaced cheeks, not intact living anatomy. Restore bilateral continuous head shield; do not copy cracks or shifted moult pieces.
Primary study shows thoracic count variability and disputed treatment of last tergite; select 20 thoracic tergites following Fig7A and Plate2 Fig1, not assert invariant species count.

Fig7A only defines selected subspecies. Fig7B/C other subspecies and Fig7D another species excluded from silhouette mixing. Field Museum photo link fetched a map, not fossil; map explicitly not morphology evidence.

No limbs, antennae, gills, mouthparts or other unpreserved ventral soft anatomy. This scoped asset is dorsal exoskeleton ONLY; must not be counted or labeled as complete living-anatomy reconstruction.
Underside is a visually neutral unsegmented shallow closure, explicitly artistic technical backing, not reconstructed ventral cuticle or hypostome. It must not resemble a base/slab.
Dorsal elevation, physical thickness and neutral coloration are artist interpretation; no preserved pigment claim.

morphology.obligation: Broad semicircular head shield with swollen anterior glabella and two crescent-like lateral eye lobes; paired long genal spines sweep backward beside anterior thorax. No stalked globular eyes, horns or triangular crab face.
morphology.source: Bergström & Levi-Setti1978 Fig7A and Plate2; frontal volume reconstructed.

morphology.obligation: 20 clearly articulated transverse thoracic tergites with central raised narrow axial lobe and bilateral pleural lobes; pleural ends sweep backward, increasingly long posteriorly. Preserve low arched cross-section, not flat fan or millipede cylinders.
morphology.source: Primary Fig7A and Plate2 Fig1; count selected as one documented variant.

morphology.obligation: Small narrow pygidium near midline and pronounced final thoracic paired sabre-like spines extending behind it; do not turn pygidium into broad horseshoe-crab shield or median telson.
morphology.source: Fig7A and Plate2 Fig2, main description.

morphology.obligation: Use a shallow neutral continuous closure that follows the dorsal exoskeleton perimeter and closes all plate/spine volumes. No walking legs, antennae, branchia, ventral segmentation or hypostome implied.
morphology.source: Technical artwork closure only; no anatomical source claim.

acceptance_obligations: Four exact-finalGLB front/side/top/perspective: top broad cephalon,20 thoracic tergites,three longitudinal lobes,swept pleura,small pygidium and paired final thoracic spines; front finite arched section/glabella/lateral eye lobes; side low but volumetric relief; perspective continuous plate roots without crossing spines.
Asset name/metadata must say fossil dorsal exoskeleton reconstruction, with artistic underside closure. No whole-living-organism claim and no appendages.

Closure must not be a rectangular slab, black void, implausible belly or DoubleSide rescue. All plate/spine surfaces outward-facing closed opaque solids. A targeted underside diagnostic only if a concrete technical closure issue is unresolved.

Two complete deterministic isolated factory-startup builds, semantic digests and metrics, default asset_common/render_candidate_views helpers; dedicated EXPORT one identity asset root and48 primitive cap.
Independent morphology QA for dorsal anatomy; full static8/GPU/runtime/scene/user acceptance separate.
production_boundary: Full static-stylized-v1 production8/GPU/scene contract is retained as reference but NOT claimed passed or imposed as current maker scope; user-requested4view model acceptance is separate.
